description:
About the company
 Our client is a software company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Act as a senior individual contributor who defines and drives a research program on how machine learning systems keep improving after deployment. Collaborate with engineers to carry experimental results through to shipped features.
 What you'll do
 - Lead a new research program from the ground up, covering how models retain knowledge, adjust quickly and get better on their own.
 - Guide technical direction as a senior contributor alongside a compact group of researchers and engineers.
 - Turn promising ideas from the roadmap into running experiments quickly.
 - Work with software and ML engineers to move findings into production, from building datasets through evaluation to integration into the product.
 - Aim for meaningful advances and share results with the wider research community.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - A doctorate, or comparable hands-on experience, in a quantitative or technical discipline.
 - About 3 to 7 years doing applied research, whether at a startup, a research lab or a large technology firm.
 - A research background in models that learn continuously, adapt with little data, improve themselves or build memory. Work in reinforcement learning or agent systems alone does not meet this bar.
 - Practical experience with post-training of large models, including supervised and reinforcement-based approaches.
 - A history of turning research concepts into working production systems, ideally in an early-stage environment.
 - Papers accepted at leading machine learning conferences or journals.
 - Strong coding skills in Python, a major deep learning framework and large-scale multi-machine training.
 - Energy for a fast-paced startup where you own outcomes.
 - Ability to work on-site at the office.
 Bonus points
 - Prior time at a research lab, large technology company or leading AI developer.
 - Experience applying post-training techniques to agents that handle long, multi-step tasks.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 200,000 to 400,000 per year
 - Equity
 Location and work model
 - San Mateo, CA, United States
 - On-site
 - Full-time
